brief: Trump threatens to withdraw his attorney general nominee amid Senate standoff, while a Senate vote to curb Iran hostilities fails. Meanwhile, Big Tech's AI spending surges, and an AI hedge fund is bailed out by Citadel.
news_summary: Trump's threat to withdraw Blanche as AG follows failed negotiations with Republican holdouts; a Senate motion to halt Iran hostilities failed 49-50. Additionally, mortgage rates hit a one-year high, and Apple's profit rose 27%.
papers_summary: No research papers were reported today.
